knowledge.content: Target 1 (App Metadata): AppMetadata struct in app.go with fields: ID string, Name string, Version string, Build int, Icon Resource. Default values when not set: ID="com.example", Name="Fyne App", Version="1.0.0", Build=1. App.Metadata() method must be added to App interface. SetMetadata function goes in app/meta.go.

Target 2 (JSON Theme): theme.FromJSON(data string) and theme.FromJSONReader(r io.Reader) both return (fyne.Theme, error). Hex color parsing must support: 3 digits (abc → aa bb cc ff), 4 digits (abcd → aa bb cc dd), 6 digits (a1b2c3 → a1 b2 c3 ff), 8 digits (a1b2c3f4 → a1 b2 c3 f4). All formats work with or without # prefix. JSON keys: Colors, Colors-dark, Colors-light, Sizes, Fonts, Icons. Color resolution: variant-specific first, then Colors, then default theme.

Target 3 (Data Binding): NewSprintf(format string, b ...DataItem) String in data/binding/sprintf.go. Returns String binding that updates when any source changes. Set() uses fmt.Sscanf to parse back. Special handling: Bytes cannot be round-tripped (returns error), URI parsed via storage.ParseURI. StringToStringWithFormat(str String, format string) String - if format is "%s" return original binding unwrapped.
Target 4 (Menu): Add Icon Resource and Shortcut Shortcut fields to MenuItem struct in menu.go. Add Refresh() method to both *Menu and *MainMenu to re-render windows displaying them.

Target 5 (Toolbar): ToolbarAction.SetIcon(icon fyne.Resource) method in widget/toolbar.go. Change return types: NewToolbarAction returns *ToolbarAction (not ToolbarItem), NewToolbarSpacer returns *ToolbarSpacer, NewToolbarSeparator returns *ToolbarSeparator.

Target 6 (Widget/Container): Container.RemoveAll() sets Objects to nil in container.go. Container.Add() must be nil-safe (no-op if nil). Hyperlink.OnTapped func() field in widget/hyperlink.go overrides URL opening when non-nil. Entry.SetMinRowsVisible(count int) in widget/entry.go for multi-line entries (default is 3 rows). validation.NewAllStrings(...fyne.StringValidator) in data/validation/all.go chains validators, returns first error.
Target 7 (Desktop App): desktop.App interface in driver/desktop/app.go with methods: SetSystemTrayMenu(menu *fyne.Menu) and SetSystemTrayIcon(icon fyne.Resource).
